summary.headline: AinsFac CNS signs KRW 1.44bn supply contract for battery control controllers with YHT
summary.what_happened: AinsFac CNS Co.,Ltd signed a single supply contract worth KRW 1.44bn to design and manufacture secondary battery control controllers domestically, with counterparty YHT Co., Ltd. The contract covers supply to the United States, runs from Oct 1, 2026 to Jul 31, 2027, and was signed on Nov 20, 2026, with the filing dated Nov 23, 2026.

key_numbers.label: Recent revenue of AinsFac CNS (FY2025 consolidated)

summary.why_it_matters: Single supply contracts disclosed by Korean listed companies typically show the scale of a new order relative to recent revenue, helping shareholders gauge its potential contribution to future sales. The payment terms, delivery period and counterparty details in such filings are generally used to assess the contract's timing and counterparty relationship.
